{
  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F001:F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "definition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Applies to an employee of a covered employer seeking to qualify as an eligible employee.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002",
          "F003",
          "F004"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001:F004",
        "choice_text": "An eligible employee must satisfy all three criteria: (1) has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months, AND (2) has been employed for at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12-month period immediately preceding the commencement of the leave, AND (3) is employed at a worksite where 50 or more employees are employed by the employer within 75 miles of that worksite.",
        "logic_quote": "F001:F004",
        "references": [
          "§ 825.801",
          "§ 825.105(b)"
        ],
        "statement": "An eligible employee is an employee of a covered employer who: (1) has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months; (2) has been employed for at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12-month period immediately preceding the commencement of the leave (referencing § 825.801 for special hours of service requirements for airline flight crew employees); and (3) is employed at a worksite where 50 or more employees are employed by the employer within 75 miles of that worksite (referencing § 825.105(b) regarding employees who work outside the U.S.)."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001:F002",
          "F005:F006"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In determining whether an employee has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months, provided that (subject to paragraph (b)(2) exceptions) employment periods prior to a break in service of seven years or more need not be counted.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "need not be",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (b)(2)"
        ],
        "statement": "The 12 months an employee must have been employed by the employer need not be consecutive months, provided that (subject to the exceptions provided in paragraph (b)(2)) employment periods prior to a break in service of seven years or more need not be counted in determining whether the employee has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F006",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001:F002",
          "F005:F006",
          "F007:F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In determining whether an employee has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months, subject to the exceptions provided in paragraph (b)(2) of this section.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "need not be counted",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F006",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (b)(2)"
        ],
        "statement": "Subject to the exceptions provided in paragraph (b)(2) of this section, employment periods prior to a break in service of seven years or more need not be counted in determining whether the employee has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F007:F009",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001:F002",
          "F005:F007"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In determining whether an employee has been employed by the employer for at least 12 months, when an employee has had a break in service of more than seven years.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must be counted",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F008",
          "F009"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F007:F009",
        "choice_text": "Employment periods preceding a break in service of more than seven years must be counted where either: (i) the break is occasioned by the fulfillment of a USERRA-covered service obligation; OR (ii) a written agreement, including a collective bargaining agreement, exists concerning
